found.compiler: the MTLCompiler image Metal loads: the highest Versions/<n> the cache holds (getMaxSupportedLLVMVersion), else the unversioned one
found.limits: the _limits ivar's offset, size and type encoding; the integer fields with an accessor in _MTLDevice or a Metal class below it (maxBufferLength: MTLIOAccelDevice's only)
found.sent: each object's protocols' methods that some image's code sends (sends.py), Metal's own and the GPU drivers' and tools' aside (interface.json not_senders)
